transcript.content: Hello, it’s nice to meet you. What brings you in today?

Honestly, I've been feeling incredibly depressed, sad, and empty inside for about the last seven months. I've completely lost interest in almost everything I used to enjoy, and I just can't seem to shake this heavy feeling.
Did these feelings start after a specific stressful event or major life change, or did they come on without a clear trigger?
I'm really not sure, to be honest. I can't think of any specific stressful event or trigger that started all of this. It just seemed to happen out of nowhere.
Before these past seven months, had you been feeling down or depressed on and off for at least two years, or is this the first time it has lasted this long?
No, I haven't really felt like this on and off for years before this. This is definitely the first time I've felt this depressed for such a long period.
Have you had any thoughts that life isn’t worth living, or thoughts of hurting yourself?

Yes, I've definitely had thoughts that life isn't worth living lately. Sometimes I find myself wishing I just wouldn't wake up in the morning. However, I don't have any specific plans to actually hurt myself or end my life.
During these seven months, how have your sleep, appetite, energy, and concentration been?

My appetite has decreased significantly nearly every day, and I barely have the desire to eat. I also feel a complete lack of motivation to do even the simplest tasks. As for my sleep and concentration, I'm not really sure about those.
Have you ever had a period lasting several days when you felt unusually energetic or euphoric, needed much less sleep, or were more impulsive than usual?

Yes, I actually had a period like that for about a month before this depression started. I felt incredibly energetic, euphoric, and was constantly on the move doing all sorts of impulsive things. I just couldn't seem to slow down because my energy was overflowing.
During that high-energy period, did you ever hear or see things others didn’t, or have very strong beliefs that others said were not true?

Yes, during that high-energy month, I actually started hearing voices when no one was around and truly believed I had special powers. Those experiences only happened when my energy was that high, though. Once that phase ended, those things completely stopped.
